# Research report: vector databases in Python
*2026-11-06 · generated by a 3-agent pipeline (Searcher → Summarizer → Writer)*

## Overview

I found 10 sources on **vector databases in Python**, including 10 open-source projects. The most widely adopted by GitHub stars is **pathwaycom/serviette** [1].
8 of the 10 projects had commits in the last 60 days, a sign of active maintenance.

## Key findings

- **pathwaycom/serviette**: A no-code RAG server that keeps answers in sync with your documents. (58,724 GitHub stars; last commit 2026-11-02; PyPI 0.1.8 (2026-10-15); licence MIT) [1]
- **rocketride-org/rocketride-server**: High-performance AI pipeline engine with a C++ core and 50+ Python-extensible nodes. (19,990 GitHub stars; last commit 2026-11-06; licence MIT) [2]
- **GanymedeNil/document.ai**: 基于向量数据库与GPT3.5的通用本地知识库方案(A universal local knowledge base solution based on vector database and GPT3.5) (3,661 GitHub stars; last commit 2023-05-12; licence AGPL-3.0) [3]
- **hegelai/prompttools**: Open-source tools for prompt testing and experimentation, with support for both LLMs (e.g. (3,060 GitHub stars; last commit 2026-02-11; PyPI 0.0.46 (2024-03-15); licence Apache-2.0) [4]
- **milvus-io/pymilvus**: Python SDK for Milvus Vector Database (1,423 GitHub stars; last commit 2026-11-06; licence Apache-2.0) [5]
- **apache/doris**: Apache Doris is a real-time analytics and hybrid search database for AI agents. (16,190 GitHub stars; last commit 2026-11-06; licence Apache-2.0) [6]
- **oceanbase/oceanbase**: OceanBase is the unified distributed database for the AI era — open-source, multi-model, one engine for your most demanding workloads. (10,366 GitHub stars; last commit 2026-11-06; licence Apache-2.0) [7]
- **HelixDB/helix-db**: HelixDB is an OLTP graph database with native vector and full-text search built in Rust on Object Storage. (6,270 GitHub stars; last commit 2026-11-06; licence Apache-2.0) [8]
